13488-an-essay-on-medi-val-economic-teac.creator: George O'Brien, Litt.D., M.R.I.A.
13488-an-essay-on-medi-val-economic-teac.description: A book by George O'Brien, Litt.D., M.R.I.A.. It is the aim of this essay to examine and present in as concise a form as possible the principles and rules which guided and regulated men in their economic and social relations during the period known as the Middle Ages.

arxiv-2002-11291.title: Fitting the trajectories of particles in the equatorial plane of a magnetic dipole with epicycloids
arxiv-2002-11291.creator: Fancong Zeng, Konstantin Kabin, Xiao-Yun Wang, Dao-bin Wang
arxiv-2002-11291.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Fancong Zeng, Konstantin Kabin, Xiao-Yun Wang, Dao-bin Wang. In this paper we discuss epicycloid approximation of the trajectories of charged particles in axisymmetric magnetic fields. Epicycloid trajectories are natural in the Guiding Center approximation and we study in detail the errors arising in this approach. We also discuss how using exact results for particle motion in the equatorial plane of a magnetic dipole the accuracy of this approximation can be significantly extended.

arxiv-2101-06688.title: Studying the D ¯ 1 ​ K \bar{D}_{1}K molecule in the Bethe-Salpeter equation approach
arxiv-2101-06688.creator: Jing-Juan Qi, Zhen-Yang Wang, Zhu-Feng Zhang, Xin-Heng Guo
arxiv-2101-06688.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Jing-Juan Qi, Zhen-Yang Wang, Zhu-Feng Zhang, Xin-Heng Guo. We interpret the X 1 ​ ( 2900 ) X_{1}(2900) as an S S -wave D ¯ 1 ​ K \bar{D}_{1}K molecular state in the Bethe-Salpeter equation approach with the ladder and instantaneous approximations for the kernel. By solving the Bethe-Salpeter equation numerically with the kernel containing one-particle-exchange diagrams and introducing three different form factors (monopole, dipole, and exponential form factors) in the verties, we find the bound state exists.

arxiv-2307-04457.title: Predicting milk traits from spectral data using Bayesian probabilistic partial least squares regression
arxiv-2307-04457.creator: Szymon Urbas, Pierre Lovera, Robert Daly, Alan O’Riordan, Donagh Berry, Isobel Claire Gormley
arxiv-2307-04457.description: Abstract High-dimensional spectral data—routinely generated in dairy production—are used to predict a range of traits in milk products. Partial least squares (PLS) regression is ubiquitously used for these prediction tasks. However, PLS regression is not typically viewed as arising from a probabilistic model, and parameter uncertainty is rarely quantified.

arxiv-2308-06144.title: Identification of the Relevance of Comments in Codes Using Bag of Words and Transformer Based Models
arxiv-2308-06144.creator: Sruthi S, Tanmay Basu
arxiv-2308-06144.description: Abstract The Forum for Information Retrieval (FIRE) started a shared task this year for classification of comments of different code segments. This is binary text classification task where the objective is to identify whether comments given for certain code segments are relevant or not.

arxiv-2309-03757.title: Compact metric spaces with infinite cop number
arxiv-2309-03757.creator: Agelos Georgakopoulos
arxiv-2309-03757.description: Abstract Mohar recently adapted the classical game of Cops and Robber from graphs to metric spaces, thereby unifying previously studied pursuit-evasion games. He conjectured that finitely many cops can win on any compact geodesic metric space, and that their number can be upper-bounded in terms of the ranks of the homology groups when the space is a simplicial pseudo-manifold.

arxiv-2402-08947.title: Switchable optical trapping of Mie-resonant phase-change nanoparticles
arxiv-2402-08947.creator: Libang Mao, Ivan Toftul, Sivacarendran Balendhran, Mohammad Taha, Yuri Kivshar, Sergey Kruk
arxiv-2402-08947.description: Abstract Optical tweezers revolutionized the manipulation of nanoscale objects. Typically, tunable manipulations of optical tweezers rely on adjusting either the trapping laser beams or the optical environment surrounding the nanoparticles. We present a novel approach to achieve tunable and switchable trapping using nanoparticles made of a phase-change material (vanadium dioxide or VO 2 ).

arxiv-2411-00323.title: Explicit estimates for the Goldbach summatory functions
arxiv-2411-00323.creator: Gautami Bhowmik, Anne-Maria Ernvall-Hytönen, Neea Palojärvi
arxiv-2411-00323.description: Abstract . In order to study the analytic properties of the Goldbach generating function we consider a smooth version, similar to the Chebyshev function for the Prime Number Theorem. In this paper, we obtain explicit numerical estimates for the average order of its summatory function both in the classical case and in arithmetic progressions.

arxiv-2412-16477.title: Bulk photovoltaic effects in altermagnets
arxiv-2412-16477.creator: Motohiko Ezawa
arxiv-2412-16477.description: Abstract The bulk photovoltaic effect is a photocurrent generation from alternating electric field, which is a promising candidate for future efficient solar cell technology. It is the second-order optical current, which is the injection current or the shift current. We focus on the direct current generation.

arxiv-2505-04714.title: Frequency Synchronization Induced by Frequency Detuning
arxiv-2505-04714.creator: Jorge Luis Ocampo-Espindola, Christian Bick, Adilson E. Motter, István Z. Kiss, ∗ Corresponding author. Email: istvan.kiss@slu.edu.
arxiv-2505-04714.description: Abstract Abstract: It is widely held that identical systems tend to behave similarly under comparable conditions. Yet, for systems that interact through a network, symmetry breaking can lead to scenarios in which this expectation does not hold. Prominent examples are chimera states in multistable phase-oscillator networks.

pmc-10565352.title: Isolation of the murine Glut1 deficient thalamocortical circuit: wavelet characterization and reverse glucose dependence of low and gamma frequency oscillations
pmc-10565352.creator: Elysandra M. Solis, Levi B. Good, Rafael Granja Vázquez, Sourav Patnaik, Ana G. Hernandez-Reynoso, Qian Ma, Gustavo Angulo, Aksharkumar Dobariya, Stuart F. Cogan, Joseph J. Pancrazio, Juan M. Pascual, Vikram Jakkamsetti
pmc-10565352.description: Glucose represents the principal brain energy source. Thus, not unexpectedly, genetic glucose transporter 1 (Glut1) deficiency (G1D) manifests with encephalopathy. G1D seizures, which constitute a prominent disease manifestation, often prove refractory to medications but may respond to therapeutic diets. These seizures are associated with aberrant thalamocortical oscillations as inferred from human electroencephalography and functional imaging.

pmc-11420238.title: Making bloodwork work: the impact of sample collection, processing, and storage on plasma glutathione measurement, and implications for translation
pmc-11420238.creator: Kendall M Coden, Duyen K K Nguyen, Roberta Moorhead, Beatriz E Stix-Brunell, Joanna N Baker, Karen J Parker, Joseph P Garner
pmc-11420238.description: Psychiatry has traditionally focused on the study of neurons and neurotransmitter physiology in the pathophysiology and treatment of psychiatric disorders. A growing literature highlights REDOX imbalance (a state in which demand for antioxidants surpasses their bioavailability) as a common pathophysiology for a diverse array of brain conditions (e.g., trichotillomania, schizophrenia, autism, Parkinson’s disease).

pmc-11585162.title: Deep learning-based Emergency Department In-hospital Cardiac Arrest Score (Deep EDICAS) for early prediction of cardiac arrest and cardiopulmonary resuscitation in the emergency department
pmc-11585162.creator: Yuan-Xiang Deng, Jyun-Yi Wang, Chia-Hsin Ko, Chien-Hua Huang, Chu-Lin Tsai, Li-Chen Fu
pmc-11585162.description: BackgroundTimely identification of deteriorating patients is crucial to prevent the progression to cardiac arrest. However, current methods predicting emergency department cardiac arrest are primarily static, rule-based with limited precision and cannot accommodate time-series data. Deep learning has the potential to continuously update data and provide more precise predictions throughout the emergency department stay.

pmc-11688472.title: A comparative study on person-centered care practice between public and private General Hospitals in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
pmc-11688472.creator: Mierage Ali, Tesfaye Getachew Charkos
pmc-11688472.description: BackgroundPerson-centered care practice has not yet been fully adopted in low- and middle-income nations such as Ethiopia. It focuses on improving several areas of patient-physician interaction. Despite Ethiopia's rapid growth in healthcare facilities, there is insufficient data available on care practices.

pmc-12471666.title: Prediction of Small for Gestational Age and Growth-Restricted Neonates at 35 to 36 Weeks of Gestation: A Multicenter Cohort Study
pmc-12471666.creator: Raquel Martin-Alonso, Catalina de Paco Matallana, Nuria Valiño, Petya Chaveeva, Themistoklis Dagklis, Antonios Siargkas, Alan Wright, Mario Camacho, Valeria Rolle, Belén Santacruz, Maria M Gil, Stefano Restaino
pmc-12471666.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background and Objectives: Third-trimester screening is widely used to identify small for gestational age (SGA) and fetal growth restriction (FGR), but optimal models and timing remain under investigation. This study aimed to assess the performance of combined maternal factors and biomarkers, including ultrasound estimated fetal weight (EFW), Doppler indices, mean arterial pressure (MAP), and angiogenic biomarkers, for predicting SGA neonates after a routine 35–36 weeks’ scan in an unselected population.

pmc-12628327.title: Cellulose–Silver and Cellulose–Gold Bioactive Nanocomposites Obtained Using SCOBY Purified Membranes
pmc-12628327.creator: Violeta Dediu, Mariana Buşilă, Claudia Ungureanu, Leontina Grigore-Gurgu, Mihaela Cotârleṭ, Cosmin Romanitan, Vasilica Tucureanu, Oana Brincoveanu, Bogdan Stefan Vasile, Gabriela Elena Bahrim
pmc-12628327.description: The green synthesis of bioactive nanomaterials is becoming more attractive in various fields like biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, cosmeceuticals, etc. In this study, bacterial cellulose–silver and bacterial cellulose–gold bionanocomposites were obtained through an environmentally friendly and low-cost method without using additional reducing agents.

pmc-12786737.title: Vertebral Ankylosis Is Associated with Reduced Cervical Extensor Muscle Bulk and Increased Fatty Degeneration
pmc-12786737.creator: Junho Song, Austen D. Katz, Alex Ngan, Andrew C. Hecht, Sheeraz A. Qureshi, Sohrab Virk
pmc-12786737.description: Background/Objectives: Ankylosing spondylitis and diffuse idiopathic skeletal hyperostosis produce long-segment spinal ankylosis, altered biomechanics, and high fracture risk in the cervical spine. Paraspinal muscle degeneration (“spine-specific sarcopenia”) has been linked to pain, disability, and worse outcomes after cervical spine surgery, but the relationship between vertebral ankylosis and cervical paraspinal muscle health is unknown.

pmc-13354128.title: Creation of a Standardized Myocardial Perfusion Single-photon Emission Computed Tomography Database to Enhance Coronary Artery Disease Research
pmc-13354128.creator: Abdurrahim Rahimian, Masoud Moslehi, Hossein Rabbani, Mahnaz Etehadtavakol, Tohid Dehghani
pmc-13354128.description: Background:Coronary artery disease (CAD) remains the leading global cause of cardiovascular mortality. Although single-photon emission computed tomography (SPECT) myocardial perfusion imaging (MPI) is widely used, progress in artificial intelligence (AI)-based diagnostic tools is constrained by the limited availability of modern, high-quality, and consistently labeled imaging datasets.

pmc-13633551.title: No clear association between time to return‐to‐play and first additional injury in European professional football players after ACL injury: A media‐based study
pmc-13633551.creator: Andrea Marchetti, Michelangelo Scordo, Lorenzo Scarpi, Massimiliano Colotti, Belinda Trobec, Raffaele Sabot, Manuela Deodato, Gianluca Canton, Luigi Murena, Ramana Piussi
pmc-13633551.description: PurposeThe primary aim of this media‐based study was to investigate whether time from anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) injury to return to play (RTP) was associated with the hazard of a first additional injury over calendar time among male professional football players in the five major European leagues.
